name: mallet
title: MALLET synth engine (marimba, vibraphone, steelpan, bells)
summary: Pick MALLET in the engine list (or the 'mallet' preset): modal synthesis of struck instruments, eight in one: MARIMBA, VIBES (with the motor's tremolo), XYLOPHONE, GLOCKENSPIEL, STEELPAN, HANDPAN, KALIMBA and TUBULAR bells. A mallet pulse (soft = only the low modes, hard = all of them and a click) excites up to six resonators tuned to the instrument's modes, each with its own decay. Page 1 INSTR MALLET DECAY STRIKE, page 2 MOTOR TUBE DETUNE TONE (knob push), page 3 = the sound's FX knobs; a built-in bank of 16 sounds (shift + blue turn). The screen draws the instrument (bars with tubes and motor discs, a pan with its note fields, kalimba tines, hanging tubes) with the sounding notes lit, the sound's name for 1 s when picked, and the page's knobs as STATION 1 (name and bar). The preset stays a drwave preset with in-range values (passes TE's boot check, loads on stock firmware as drwave).
controls: engine list: MALLET; preset browser: folder mallet (one preset, 'mallet'); the sounds are in the built-in bank (shift + blue turn)
MALLET sound: knob push cycles page 1 (INSTR MALLET DECAY STRIKE) / page 2 (MOTOR TUBE DETUNE TONE) / page 3 (the sound's FX knobs 1-4, as on TE's FX screen)
MALLET sound: shift + blue turn browses the built-in bank (16 sounds)

sql: INSERT INTO synth_types (id, type, default_params) SELECT MAX(id) + 1, 'mallet', '[1024, 7372, 8192, 8191, 28672, 30719, 30720, 32152]' FROM synth_types
